properties.name: OPEN (B, from Tao's AI views): should a source say what KIND of support it gives (a worked proof, a statement only, a paraphrase, peer-reviewed or not), so a citation it backs reads no stronger than that, instead of fully "checked"?
properties.rationale: A "checked" reading that says more than its source shows is exactly the overclaim reflow2 exists to prevent; Tao's point and today's measurement agree. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
